comment: She is amazing! I would take her class all over again if I could! The material was not too bad (coming from a non-psych major), and Dr.Berry makes it as digestible as possible. There are SO MANY opportunities for extra credit! Quizzes are self-checked by students and also have extra credit! Exams are relatively straightforward.

Dr. Berry is a lovely woman; however, she is not the best teacher, and I found her class to be a little difficult to follow and not engaging. She grades very harshly and takes an unfair and arbitrary amount of points off of things that do not deserve it. No study guides, and tests are hard to study for. Overall, wouldn't recommend sorry
Aging while Black was a great class to take for Psych 299! It ended up being very interesting and the book is actually very entertaining. Dr. Berry is so sweet and really cares about her students.

psych 299: LOVEEEE DR BERRY. she's such a queen and so helpful and extremely caring and accommodating. class gets hard after the mid terms but it's manageable if you keep up with the textbook! very fair exams and easy final paper!

DR. BERRY IS THE BEST! I've had her twice now and she is an absolute GEM. I had no knowledge of Metamemory before taking her course and now I feel I actually know so much! Discussions were engaging and fun, as long as you are fully prepared. Get ready for cool assignments. Interesting course with an awesome prof at the helm. TAKE THIS IF YOU CAN!

Dr. Berry's Adult Development class is a lot of work, but that is expected at that level. It's a dense class that Dr. Berry makes very interesting, and she makes her discussions in class as inclusive as possible. She is clearly passionate and very knowledgeable about the subject, and she cares deeply about her students and isn't just there for pay.

I LOVE Dr. Berry! She is the sweetest woman and really cares about her students and about elderly people (her focus is geronotology). There is a lot of reading but that is expected at this level of class. Super understanding and now is my research advisor and boss!

Of the three professors that team-teach psych 100, I thought Dr. Berry was the worst. Her powerpoints were useless outside of class and her lectures were monotonous and difficult to pay attention to. Her test was very difficult in comparison to the others but there was a decent curve. Pay attention to the figures, they'll be half your test points.

There is A LOT of work for this class. She expects you to be able to read about 50 pages for each class and you have to do them because there are Pop quizzes. Also there is a CBL component and a lab where you have to use SPSS and write a lab report based on your findings. TOUGH CLASS

SUPER nice woman. Has your best interest at heart.  Lecture based class, can feel a bit rehearsed and long, but the test is easy. Do the practice test, it insures you an easy A.  Always there to help.

Very nice and informative- her lectures are always packed with info. Her notes can be extensive, so I would highly recommend reading the book section she covers before the test. Study well and her test is absolute cake, it's the kind of test that knowing the material and actually trying garauntees you an A or A-. Overall a great teacher!

Had her for CORE, at first I was a bit disappointed, but grew to love her. She is a tough grader but very understanding. She tries to include everyone and make class discussions interesting. I think this was her last year teaching CORE, but I would take her for her other Psych classes.
really nice professor, but tough essay grader. helps you understand the books, but participation in class is necessary. there isn't too much outside wor besides reading the novels
Dr. Berry is a first-time CORE teacher and has trouble communicating what she wants from us. She is also a REALLY tough grader on papers. Good luck if you get her for CORE.
Probably the coolest and most understanding professor I've had yet.

Dr. Berry is an AWESOME professor. She is very nice, very smart and extremely positive and helpful. She is the kind of professor that tells you how it is and can relate on our level. She is not an easy prof, however, that doesn't matter because she is so much fun. You really learn alot.
